name: Amitabha Buddha
summary:
Key Features：
• Automatically counts Buddha-name recitations with speech recognition.
• Works offline (initial setup requires internet to download the language model).
• Logs daily recitation counts and shows total statistics.
• Supports English and Traditional Chinese.

Privacy：
• Audio is processed on the device only
• No recordings are stored or uploaded
• No login, no ads, no in-app purchases
